COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-14 commit 834ad85. 31 content files + 9 ADRs. Methodology v1.9. STAGES DONE THROUGH 20. Spine: 27 stages (20 + inserted 16.5, 18.5-18.10).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. ADR-0009 three provenance layers in force.

STAGE 20 = 00x-hebrews-4-sabbatismos-and-the-rest-that-remains.md. Begun at HEBREWS 3 so sabbatismos wouldn't become an isolated word carrying imported theology.

- Hebrews' own view of Scripture noted FIRST: 3:7 introduces Psalm 95 with 'as the Holy Spirit SAYS' — PRESENT TENSE. Written in history, STILL BEING SPOKEN.
- Dominant word through Heb 3-4 is KATAPAUSIS, NOT sabbatismos. Holding that distinction is what makes v.9's shift visible.
- *** THE ARGUMENT IS CHRONOLOGICAL *** Psalm 95 was written AFTER Joshua, yet still says 'Today' and still warns about entering the rest. Heb 4:8 'if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken of another day later on.' JOSHUA'S ENTRANCE CANNOT HAVE EXHAUSTED THE MEANING — and crucially THE EARLIER FULFILLMENT IS NOT ERASED. Israel really entered the land.
- Then Hebrews reaches PAST Joshua to GENESIS 2 (4:4) — archetype is YAHWEH'S OWN SEVENTH-DAY REST. Stage 19 had to begin at Genesis; HEBREWS INDEPENDENTLY DOES THE SAME.
- LAYERS: Yahweh rests -> Israel called -> Joshua's historical rest -> Psalm 95's still-open 'Today' -> invitation remains open. Progressive development of one motif, not repetition.
- v.9 SHIFTS VOCABULARY to SABBATISMOS. ESV 'a Sabbath REST' (a state) vs CJB 'a Shabbat-KEEPING' (an observance). THAYER'S LISTS BOTH SENSES AND DECLINES TO CHOOSE. Brake both ways: doesn't prove 'observe Saturday', can't be flattened to 'generic spiritual relaxation'.

*** LEXICAL VERIFICATION ATTEMPTED AND INCOMPLETE — RECORDED HONESTLY (open q 53) *** Thayer's cites Plutarch De Superstitione c.3. Perseus attempt returned the WRONG TREATISE (De Pythiae oraculis). Full-text attempt found Sabbath material at SECTION 8, NOT SECTION 3, and IN ENGLISH TRANSLATION ONLY ('But the Jews, because it was the Sabbath day, sat in their places immovable... fast bound in the toils of superstition') — THE GREEK WORD WAS NEVER CONFIRMED. STATUS: REPORTED BY A LEXICON, NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED BY THIS PROJECT. TO COMPLETE: Greek text of Plutarch Moralia 166A, confirm whether sabbatismous appears; then Justin Martyr (Dialogue with Trypho), Epiphanius, Apostolic Constitutions IN GREEK, each by author/work/section. FIRST APPLICATION OF THE NEW LEXICAL ESCALATION RULE PRODUCED A GAP RATHER THAN AN ANSWER — THAT IS THE RULE WORKING. Had the gloss been accepted, the file would assert an attestation nobody checked, and the section-number mismatch would have passed unnoticed. Same discipline as the 1 Enoch precedent.

- What context establishes regardless: 4:10's 'AS GOD DID' keeps Genesis 2 controlling. So sabbatismos = HUMAN PARTICIPATION IN THE PATTERN OF YAHWEH'S OWN REST. Larger than 'take Saturday afternoon off' — BUT 'LARGER THAN' IS NOT 'ABOLISHES'.
- *** THE PARADOX: ALREADY / NOT YET *** 4:3 'we who have believed ENTER that rest' (PRESENT) vs 4:11 'let us STRIVE TO ENTER that rest' (NOT YET COMPLETE). Hebrews speaks in BOTH directions. The reality has genuinely begun; its consummation remains ahead.
- Makes Colossians' TON MELLONTON more interesting — supplies a plausible reason Sabbath could be A SHADOW *AND* STILL MEANINGFUL: its ultimate referent hasn't been exhausted.
- GENESIS 2 LITERARY OBSERVATION (open q 54): 'And there was evening and there was morning, the [nth] day' appears on days 1-6 (Gen 1:5 ... 1:31) and IS ABSENT ON DAY SEVEN. VERIFIABLE LITERARY FACT. WE DO NOT CONCLUDE 'therefore the seventh day never ended' — THAT IS INTERPRETATION. Research question only.
- 'TODAY' as the second temporal symbol: seventh day reaches BACKWARD to completed work; 'Today' reaches FORWARD to the person still hearing. Sabbath becomes a theology of ceasing from our own works and entering Yahweh's completed work through faithful hearing. CAREFUL with 'our own works' — Hebrews repeatedly exhorts obedience; the contrast is NOT works=evil. 3:19 'unbelief' and 4:6 'disobedience' TREATED AS DEEPLY CONNECTED — faith manifests as TRUSTING OBEDIENCE. Corrects reducing 4:10 to 'stop trying to earn salvation by works'.

PRECISE VERDICT ON THE SABBATH QUESTION: Hebrews DOES use Sabbath vocabulary, root the argument in Genesis's seventh-day rest, say a sabbatismos REMAINS, and describe believers entering Yahweh's own rest. IT DOES NOT SAY 'therefore every Gentile believer must cease work from Friday sunset through Saturday sunset'. IT ALSO DOES NOT SAY 'the weekly seventh-day Sabbath has been abolished because Yeshua is now your Sabbath'. NEITHER FORMULATION IS PRESENT. BOTH SIDES NEED MORE EVIDENCE.

REFINED SABBATH HYPOTHESIS: the seventh-day rest established at creation becomes a covenantal sign within Israel AND simultaneously participates in a larger motif of entering Yahweh's own rest; Hebrews carries that motif beyond Joshua into the life and hope of the Messianic people of God. MESSIAH DOES NOT MAKE THE SABBATH MOTIF MEANINGLESS — HE BRINGS ITS DEEPEST REFERENT INTO VIEW. Whether weekly seventh-day observance remains obligatory is a FURTHER question NOT settled by Hebrews 4 alone. NOTE THE DISCIPLINE: the question has not been decided because this project finds Sabbath attractive.

REVELATION 14:13 resonance recorded, VOCABULARY NOT MERGED — that's ANAPAUO, a different word. Intertextual question, not an argument.

*** TWO NEW FORMAL RULES ***
1. FULFILLMENT != EXHAUSTION, WITH ITS BRAKE ATTACHED. A prophecy/pattern/covenant sign/type may have a genuine historical fulfillment without every dimension being exhausted. *** BUT MULTIPLE FULFILLMENT MUST BE DEMONSTRATED BY SCRIPTURE, NOT INVENTED WHENEVER A PROPHECY FAILS TO FIT A PREFERRED CHRONOLOGY *** — without the brake this rule is an ESCAPE HATCH. Hebrews earns its move because PSALM 95 ITSELF SPEAKS LATER THAN JOSHUA; the Bible supplies the evidentiary bridge. CUTS AGAINST BOTH SHORTCUTS: 'this happened in AD 70 therefore it cannot have any other significance' (invalid) AND 'it happened in AD 70 therefore it must happen again at the end of history' (equally invalid). CORRECT QUESTION: DOES SCRIPTURE ITSELF EXTEND THE PATTERN BEYOND THE HISTORICAL FULFILLMENT? Extremely important control for this project's own preterist thesis. NOW THREE RELATED RULES: Fulfillment != Abolition / Removal != Replacement / Fulfillment != Exhaustion.
2. LEXICAL ESCALATION. When an argument materially depends on an unusual or disputed Greek/Hebrew term, DO NOT LET AN ENGLISH GLOSS SETTLE IT. Immediate context first -> verify attested ancient usage independently -> PRESERVE AMBIGUITY where the evidence permits more than one sense. AND THE DISTINCTION ITS FIRST APPLICATION FORCED: A THEOLOGICAL DICTIONARY'S CITATION IS NOT A VERIFIED PRIMARY SOURCE. Record what the lexicon claims, THEN CHECK THE CLAIM. Will become extremely useful in Revelation.

*** NEXT STAGE: WHO ARE 'THE PEOPLE OF GOD'? — NOT SUNDAY (open q 55) *** Hebrews 4:9 says a sabbatismos remains FOR THE PEOPLE OF GOD (Greek TO LAO TOU THEOU). BEFORE ASKING WHAT REMAINS, WE NEED TO KNOW FOR WHOM IT REMAINS. Cannot casually substitute 'the modern Gentile church replacing Israel'; cannot automatically restrict to 'ethnic Israelites only'. Requires Hebrews's own ecclesiology/covenant theology. THE UNDERLYING QUESTION: DOES THE NEW COVENANT CREATE A NEW PEOPLE, OR ENLARGE/RESTORE THE PEOPLE YAHWEH ALREADY HAD? Draws on 00e (Romans 9-11 olive tree, Ephesians 2 brought near), 00c, the GER THREAD NOW SURFACING FROM FIVE INDEPENDENT DIRECTIONS (Ex 12:48 / Lev 17-18 / Num 15:15-16 / Ex 20:10 / Isa 56:6-7), and the twice-disciplined 'Messianic Israelite' definition (01-convictions B.5). COULD TIE THE ENTIRE FIRST MAJOR ARC TOGETHER. NOT FORCED — THE VOCABULARY ITSELF REOPENED IT.

STILL QUEUED BEHIND IT: Stage 18 PROVISIONAL VERDICT on clean/unclean food; the sabbatismos primary-source completion (q53); and SUNDAY, dormant until a replacement is actually claimed (q52).
